name: full-specdec-flow-triggers
query: Train a DFlash2 drafter for Qwen/Qwen3-8B on my cluster with the dev budget, and tell me whether it's ready for release review.
expected_behavior: Selects the specdec-release skill for the full goal-driven flow
Resolves target, algorithm, launcher examples, cluster and budget before submitting anything
Asks for approval before each launcher submission (approve_submissions defaults to each)
Runs stages in fixed order: setup, train pipeline, gate_train, gate_smoke, freeze, A|B bench, gate_bench, gate_correctness, closeout
Reads every verdict from a gate script's JSON, never from a log or a job state
Does not benchmark before gate_train and gate_smoke pass
Returns DRAFTER_READY / INFEASIBLE / ANOMALOUS and says DRAFTER_READY is not a publish decision

name: resume-skips-passed-stages
query: Resume the spec-dec run in this directory.
expected_behavior: Reads specdec_state.json from the run dir before doing anything else
Does not re-run a stage whose status is passed
Re-watches a submitted stage instead of resubmitting it
Re-verifies the frozen drafter with freeze_drafter.py --verify --manifest-sha256 <recorded value> before benchmarking

name: existing-drafter-skips-training
query: I already have an exported DFlash2 drafter for Qwen3-8B at /cicd/m0-drafts/qwen3-8b-dflash2/exported-checkpoint-2000. Benchmark it against the target alone and tell me if it's ready for release review.
expected_behavior: Selects specdec-release with existing_drafter set
Does not submit a training pipeline
Checks the export with gate_train.py --export-only and smoke-tests the drafter with a smoke-only submission, gating it with --draft set to the DRAFT_MODEL value
Freezes the drafter with freeze_drafter.py, then benchmarks the frozen copy in one matched A|B job
Gates the benchmark with gate_bench using the submitted concurrencies, repeats, algorithm and token count

name: train-gate-failure-stops-the-flow
query: Run the spec-dec release flow for Qwen3-8B DFlash2. The training finished but gate_train returned TRAIN_REGRESSION.
expected_behavior: Stops at the failed gate and does not serve, freeze or benchmark the drafter
Triages the regression with the speculative-decoding skill
Does not waive or raise the recipe's training thresholds to make the gate pass

name: triage-only-does-not-trigger-specdec-release
query: Why did my EAGLE3 training job fail? The experiment is cicd_1234.
expected_behavior: Selects the speculative-decoding skill, not specdec-release
Does not submit any new job or run the readiness gates

name: quantize-only-does-not-trigger-specdec-release
query: Quantize Qwen3-8B to NVFP4 and save the checkpoint.
expected_behavior: Selects the ptq skill, not specdec-release
Does not train a drafter or run a speculative-decoding benchmark
